about: NL-1 paid TRIAL: 10 representative DEVELOPMENT requests (never sealed). One of each kind the eval measures. Keys are tools/agent_eval_run.py --keys values (case id, '#n' = conversation turn n).

keys.why: reference by symbol on a two-chart board
two charts, two changes in one sentence
genuinely ambiguous: must ask, with both charts as choices
unsupported (an order): must say so, change nothing
a plain question: answer, change nothing
correction: 'no I meant 15' after a 5-minute switch
follow-up that is NOT a correction ('do the same on the other one')
